full_track.tags: K-Pop ballad. Female vocals with a breathy, intimate delivery in the lower register. Clean electric guitar plays arpeggiated chords with a light chorus effect. A fretless bass guitar performs melodic slides and syncopated fills. Subtle digital percussion includes a soft rimshot on the backbeat and a muted kick drum. Orchestral string pads provide sustained harmonic support. Key of E Major. Tempo is 72 BPM. 4/4 time signature.
